alt: A small white cube-shaped device on a workbench being tested — it looks like a compact desktop fan, not an air conditioner
story: Social-media ads for cheap 'portable air conditioners' — claiming NASA engineering and a 17°C room-drop in minutes — are going viral in the UK heatwave; a YouTuber who bought one found a small evaporative fan worth a few pounds; the ASA confirmed the claims are false and is banning the ads.
why_funny: The product was marketed with AI-generated copper-coil imagery and fake customer reviews, but opens to reveal a tiny plastic box fan that can't meaningfully cool a closet.
